audit_scope: REAL-TIME EXCHANGE VERIFICATION (Zero Synthetic Data / Zero Lookahead)

summary.primary_bottleneck: 1-Day target ATR multipliers did not scale down for large-cap macro beta drag and open-gap fade dynamics.
summary.pipeline_fix_action: Implement Dynamic Beta Drag Discounting, Gap-Fade Suppression, and Multi-Horizon Scaling (1.0x ATR for T+1, 2.5x ATR for T+5).

yesterday_signals_t1_audit.headline: USD 450M generative AI cloud modernization deal over 5 years
yesterday_signals_t1_audit.failure_mode_analysis: None. Strong institutional accumulation in large-cap IT pushed stock straight into the top boundary of predicted target.

yesterday_signals_t1_audit.headline: INR 12,500 Cr High-Speed Rail bullet train viaduct & terminal contract
yesterday_signals_t1_audit.failure_mode_analysis: Direction was positive (+1.14%), but target corridor (+2.28% to +4.24%) was too wide for a ₹5.2 Lakh Cr market-cap stock in 1 single session. Capex contract materiality requires T+5 multi-day horizon.

yesterday_signals_t1_audit.headline: 1,200 MW ultra-mega solar-wind hybrid SECI tender win
yesterday_signals_t1_audit.failure_mode_analysis: Peak price ₹323.95 reached within 0.30% of target lower threshold ₹324.91. Broad utility sector consolidation restricted the final intraday push.

yesterday_signals_t1_audit.headline: US FDA Form 483 with 6 critical observations at Pithampur API facility
yesterday_signals_t1_audit.failure_mode_analysis: Short trade was highly profitable (dropped -2.10% from ₹1,387.90 to low ₹1,358.80), but RAG archetype pegged target too aggressively (-5.75%) based on historical Import Alerts rather than 483 observations.

yesterday_signals_t1_audit.headline: Generic Deferasirox 180-day market exclusivity USD 280M market
yesterday_signals_t1_audit.failure_mode_analysis: Opened high at ₹1,861.30 (+0.87%) into pre-market excitement, but institutional profit-booking faded the opening gap. Pipeline failed to detect pre-market extended RSI.

yesterday_signals_t1_audit.headline: Unverified WhatsApp rumor of 8% discount OFS stake sale
yesterday_signals_t1_audit.failure_mode_analysis: Correctly abstained from trading on social media rumor, preserving risk capacity for high-conviction filings.

systemic_root_cause_analysis.why_it_happened: The model assigned multi-day reaction volatility (+3% to +6%) to 1-day (T+1) horizon. Large caps like L&T, NTPC, Sun Pharma have average daily true range of only 1.1% to 1.6%.
systemic_root_cause_analysis.engineering_fix: Scale 1-Day (T+1) target bounds strictly to (0.7x to 1.2x Daily ATR). Reserve >3% target bounds strictly for T+5 / T+10 multi-horizon swings.

systemic_root_cause_analysis.why_it_happened: Positive FDA approvals (Sun Pharma) or contracts often cause early pre-market gap-ups that short-term momentum traders immediately sell into, producing red intraday candles.
systemic_root_cause_analysis.engineering_fix: Add Gap-Fade Check: If stock opens >0.8% above previous close and RSI_15min > 70, convert execution from Market Order to Limit Order at VWAP pullback.

systemic_root_cause_analysis.why_it_happened: Stock news was evaluated in isolation without checking if the respective Sectoral Index (Nifty Pharma, Nifty PSE, Nifty Metal) was facing sector-wide profit taking.
systemic_root_cause_analysis.engineering_fix: Incorporate Sector Relative Strength (RS) Index into the Confluence Engine alongside Nifty 50.
